name: [💸] Money Printer Tycoon!
desc:
💸 Welcome to Money Printer Tycoon! 💸

HOW DO I PLAY? 🤔
🖨️ Buy & place money printers on your plot
⚙️ Connect conveyors to auto-collect every dollar 
🏭 Expand your factory and unlock new areas
⚡ Compete with other tycoons on the same server

🚀 Your factory PRINTS MONEY OFFLINE!
